title: totalfloat history merge --json
description: Another branch's edits brought onto the checked-out branch. Conflicts refuse the merge with a totalfloat.error/1 document listing each.

fast_forward.description: True if the branch only moved forward to the other's head, recording nothing new.

replayed.description: The other branch's changesets replayed, oldest first.

impact.description: A totalfloat.diff/1 report from the branch head to the merged file, or null.
